# Independent native F10/F11 reviews

Twelve opaque outputs were reviewed independently: six prompt-only outputs and six supplied-reference implementations. All meet the frozen applicable quality floor in these original reviews. This is no comparison or adoption decision.

The six F10 results contain one self-contained requested prompt and no product change or generation. Each performed only the protocol-mandated guidance read. Rendered visual and implemented interaction dimensions are not applicable to a prompt.

For F11, the reviewer opened each actual reference, wide screenshot, narrow screenshot and modal screenshot; read implementation and browser helper source; inspected actual execution output and all native tool semantics. All retain visible reference content and demonstrate local membership behavior. Minor retained limitations: da563 lacks the details-link/family route and checkout action metadata; da563,25dc and5195 use6px email corners instead of12px;5195 omits checkout action metadata. Common facts absent from the supplied reference are not automatically required visible copy.

All six original shared browser observers failed before interacting with the hidden email field. Original failure supplements bind the exact transport, unchanged source/copy and partial images. Those images equal the already-opened author captures byte for byte. Original grades rely on inspected authored runtime evidence, not an invented uniform observer pass. Any subsequent dialog-aware observation must be recorded separately and cannot replace original failures or grades.

`index.json` inventories the original12 grades. `binding-validation.json` records read-only verification of158 bundle files,24 supplement files,86 completed tools,24 opened images and66 required checks. `verify-bindings.py` verifies integrity/coverage only; it does not grade. Item hashes use Python canonical JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and default ASCII escaping; event lines are one-based. All bundle files are bound in each original review.

Four passes covered scope/coverage, actual domain evidence, contradictions/authority, and presentation/bindings. Partial guidance disclosures in model output and the reviewer's prior capture-infrastructure work limit blinding; no variant mapping, original guidance lookup or raw trial lookup was used. No new model execution, rerender, product edit or publication occurred during review. Parent acceptance remains separate.
